description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §5.7): Millford's shepherds lost sheep to the wolves denning in the Barrow Fields (Reeve Tamsin asks; the quest also starts when the giant finds the fields). Clear the pack and its barrow-warden ogre: 120 XP, the barrow-king's arm-ring (a trophy) and 1 iron.

stages.objective: Clear the wolves and their ogre warden from the Barrow Fields
